Title: Azure App Configuration is now in preview

Body.Content:
App Configuration is a new Azure service that enables fast, scalable parameter storage for all your app configurations.

Previously, developers had to store app configurations with their code. This was both difficult to take to scale and promoted poor security practices. App Configuration solves this problem by letting you easily scale app configurations across multiple environments, eliminating difficult to track errors across environments, while also ensuring that your app configuration data is stored securely away from your code.

Learn more
